name: Security Testing
purpose: Identify security-related test scenarios that are directly supported by the provided requirements and project documentation.

apply_when: The requirement describes roles or permissions.
The requirement describes sessions or tokens.
The requirement describes credentials or sensitive information.
The requirement explicitly describes security controls.
The requirement describes protection against a specific attack or invalid input.
The requirement describes security-related failure behavior.
do_not_apply_when: The security behavior is not supported by the supplied requirements or project documentation.
The scenario would require inventing a security policy.
The scenario would require inventing a role or permission.
The scenario would require inventing a security threshold.
A security control is not mentioned or reasonably derived from an explicit requirement.

coverage_dimensions.name: Authentication
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify authentication behavior when authentication is explicitly required.

coverage_dimensions.name: Credential Validation
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify credential validation when credentials are explicitly part of the requirement.

coverage_dimensions.name: Invalid Credentials
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify explicitly defined behavior for invalid credentials.

coverage_dimensions.name: Authorization
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify access restrictions when authorization rules are explicitly defined.

coverage_dimensions.name: Role and Permission Boundaries
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify explicitly defined role or permission boundaries.

coverage_dimensions.name: Session Management
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify session behavior when session requirements are explicitly described.

coverage_dimensions.name: Token Handling
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify token behavior when tokens are explicitly part of the requirement.

coverage_dimensions.name: Token Expiration
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify token expiration only when expiration behavior or duration is explicitly specified.

coverage_dimensions.name: Token Invalidity
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify invalid-token behavior when token validation is explicitly required.

coverage_dimensions.name: Injection Protection
coverage_dimensions.description: Test injection attempts when the requirement explicitly addresses input security, injection protection, or a security-sensitive input.

coverage_dimensions.name: SQL Injection
coverage_dimensions.description: Test SQL injection when SQL/database input protection is explicitly relevant to the requirement or project documentation.

coverage_dimensions.name: Cross-Site Scripting
coverage_dimensions.description: Test XSS when user-controlled input is rendered or the requirement explicitly requires XSS protection.

coverage_dimensions.name: Sensitive Information Exposure
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify that explicitly sensitive information is handled according to stated requirements.

coverage_dimensions.name: Security Error Handling
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify security-related error behavior when explicitly defined.

coverage_dimensions.name: Brute Force Protection
coverage_dimensions.description: Test repeated authentication attempts only when brute-force protection, login-attempt limits, or equivalent behavior is explicitly defined.

coverage_dimensions.name: Rate Limiting
coverage_dimensions.description: Test rate limiting only when a rate limit or request restriction is explicitly specified.

coverage_dimensions.name: Account Lockout
coverage_dimensions.description: Test account lockout only when lockout behavior is explicitly specified.

coverage_dimensions.name: Security Bypass
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify explicitly defined access-control or authentication bypass protections.

security_boundary_rules.security_behavior_implied_by_explicit_in: Generate only the security scenarios reasonably derived from that behavior.
security_boundary_rules.missing_security_policy: Report the missing policy as a QA gap rather than inventing one.
security_boundary_rules.uncertain_security_behavior: Use 'Requires QA Input' where an expected security behavior is necessary but unspecified.

examples.requirement: Users authenticate using email and password.
The system rejects SQL injection attempts in the login fields.
applicable_scenarios: Injection attempt does not bypass authentication
Application does not expose database errors

examples.requirement: Users remain authenticated for 30 days when Remember Me is selected.
applicable_scenarios: Session remains valid within the stated period
Session expires after the stated period

unknown_information.rule: Missing security requirements must be identified as gaps and must not be silently invented.
